hunting: Baseline/adaptive: 65% center aim, stationary hunter, actual cover/reload/escape. Hunting study: 35/65/90% center aim, visible highest-meat target, lower-clearing movement when obstructed, 0.25s live ticks. Misses go to (0,0). Scripted skill assumptions, not measured player skill or pathfinding.
outfit: Current suggested cart for every profession; see outfitting_rules for exact quantities/prices/budgets.
policy: Bulk buy below 900 lb when affordable; passing-wagon buy below 90; hunt below 45 (adaptive: 90, hunting study: profile threshold); rest below 70 health or above 50 fatigue only with food. Adaptive holds $10 when buying food and sells supplies if blocked at toll. Hunting study watches worst individual health and provides care below 55 if an active condition and kit/cash available, at least 3 days apart; $10 cash reserve. Other batches no paid care. First affordable event choice; ferry or stage-appropriate crossing. Mixed/preservation profiles use two lb when well, three if any living traveler has a condition or internal health below 80. Preservation profiles process leftover fresh meat before buying/care; salt mode falls back to unsalted drying and attempts a salt purchase before hunting below five lb salt when cash >= $12. Spare-ox profile shoots one spare animal below90 food before buying food, then preserves using the same rules; never buys animals solely for food and never uses hand tools. Stop at 365 days/2400 actions or unresolvable choice.
